title: Coolbets
tagline: CoolBets: A multi-chain platform for trading opinions. Stake your insights, mint NFT bets, and shape the future across Rootstock, Chilliz, Morph L2, and Base networks. Where predictions meet profit!
description:
CoolBets is a revolutionary decentralized opinion trading platform that operates across multiple blockchain networks, including Rootstock, Chilliz, Morph L2, and Base. Our platform empowers users to stake their beliefs on various topics and potentially profit from their insights.
Key features include:

Multi-chain support for seamless operation across different networks.
NFT-based betting system where each bet is minted as a unique NFT, adding value and collectibility to user interactions.
Transparent reward distribution powered by smart contracts.
Decentralized governance allowing community-driven proposals and voting.
Integration with Sign Protocol for bet attestations, enhancing trust and verifiability.
A vision to implement Futarchy for collective decision-making based on user opinions.

CoolBets aims to revolutionize prediction markets by creating a decentralized ecosystem where users can challenge conventional wisdom, engage with ideas, and potentially earn rewards for their foresight.
how_its_made: Foundry was used for testing, deploying, and interacting with smart contracts.Built with Next.js and TypeScript, providing a responsive and type-safe user interface. Each bet is minted as a unique NFT, adding a layer of value and collectibility to user interactions.Implemented support for Rootstock, Chilliz, Morph L2, and Base networks, allowing for a diverse and robust ecosystem.Integrated Sign Protocol for bet attestations, enhancing the trust and verifiability of each bet.
